standard.summary: LoRA 权重矩阵 stable rank 下降超过此比例视为崩溃，触发 AutoController 干预。默认 0.3（下降 30%）。
standard.effect: stable rank 崩溃通常意味着 LoRA 权重退化为低秩，有效表达能力降低。
standard.whenToUse: 使用较高 rank（>=16）的 LoRA 时开启以防止 rank 崩溃。
standard.avoidWhen: 本来就使用极低 rank（rank=1~2）时 stable rank 本身就低，此监控无意义。

standard_en.summary: A stable-rank drop of the LoRA weight matrix beyond this ratio counts as a collapse and triggers AutoController intervention. Default 0.3, i.e. a 30% drop.
standard_en.effect: A stable-rank collapse usually means the LoRA weights degenerated to a lower rank and lost expressive capacity.
standard_en.whenToUse: Turn it on with a higher-rank LoRA (16 or above) to guard against rank collapse.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Pointless at an extremely low rank (1 or 2), where the stable rank is inherently low anyway.

advanced.principle: stable_rank = (‖W‖_F)² / (‖W‖_2)²，崩溃检测 = (baseline_rank - current_rank) / baseline_rank > threshold。
advanced.tradeoffs: 计算 stable rank 需要 SVD，对大矩阵开销可观。

advanced_en.principle: stable_rank = (‖W‖_F)² / (‖W‖_2)²; collapse detection = (baseline_rank - current_rank) / baseline_rank > threshold.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Computing stable rank requires SVD, which is costly for large matrices.
